description.zh-CN: 试用版：把参考图和商品图一起交给编辑模型直接融合；结果是模型直接输出的，未贴回原商品，多角度商品会把全部角度一起送给模型。只在“照参考图做”的“直接融合（试用）”开关中使用。
description.en: Trial version: hands the reference and the product photos to the edit model together; the result is the model's direct output, the original product is not pasted back, and a multi-angle product sends all of its angles. Used only by the "direct fusion (trial)" switch of "follow a reference".
